description.value:
You lash out with raw psychic force, targeting as many as ten creatures you choose within range; any target with an Intelligence score of 2 or lower is unaffected. Each must attempt an Intelligence saving throw, taking 14d6 psychic damage and becoming stunned on a failure, or half as much damage with no stun on a success.

A stunned target may attempt a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 9
